lighting.method: static light estimate (delve-admit, the compiler's block+sky flood): min over 195 floor cell(s) reachable on foot from 22 ground-level entry cell(s), of 305 standable in the region box; the piece stands in open air, so sky light enters through its openings. Re-probe live for borderline pieces.
